title: OSVVM build summary, format version 0.1
description: The build summary '<build>.yml' OSVVM writes per build. Derived from OSVVM's writers 'OsvvmScriptsCreateYamlReports.tcl' (Tcl) and 'ReportPkg.vhd', 'AlertLogPkg.vhd' (VHDL), and OSVVM's reader 'ReportBuildYaml2Dict.tcl'. Timestamps are ISO 8601; the reader converts unquoted YAML timestamps to strings before validation.

Date.description: Time OSVVM started to write the file.

TestSuites.description: The build's test suites; absent if the build simulated no test.

AlertCount.description: Numbers of failures, errors and warnings (OSVVM's AlertCountType).

Status.description: Status of a test case: written by AlertLogPkg's GetTestResultStatus or, for SKIPPED and ANALYZE_FAILED, by OSVVM's scripts.

Results.description: A test case's results. 'ExpectedCount' since OSVVM 2025.06.

TestCase.description: A test case. A skipped one, or one that failed to analyze, has 'Reason' and no 'TestCaseFileName'; a simulation without results has no 'Status' and no 'Results'.

Name.description: Name of the test, as its VHDL code states it.

Reason.description: Reason of a skipped test case, or of a failed analysis.

FunctionalCoverage.description: Functional coverage in percent; empty without coverage model.

SimulationTime.description: Simulated time, as VHDL's to_string(NOW) writes it.

TestCaseFileName.description: Base name of the test case's report files: the test's name extended by the generics' values.

ElapsedTime.description: Duration of the simulation in seconds.

TestSuite.description: A test suite and its test cases.

ElapsedTime.description: Duration of the test suite's simulations in seconds.
Duration of the build in seconds.

Simulator.description: Name of the simulator, followed by its arguments, if any.

OsvvmVersion.description: OSVVM's version YYYY.MM, optionally followed by a revision letter.

OsvvmSettingsInfo.description: OSVVM's settings: where it put the build's reports and logs. An empty string means OSVVM wrote no such file.

CoverageSubdirectory.description: The build's code coverage report file.
